address: 13 rue de l'Abbaye (Le Bourg), Saint-Avit-Sénieur, 24440, France
bio: This stone - built house in the heart of the village has a pretty terrace overlooking the church square. Inside, you will discover a great little restaurant with a chef who dares to branch out from the usual regional fare. He pays special attention to his ingredients and how best to present and cook them....
